nodes.label: Availability recheck: Butter Nav
nodes.summary:
The primary URL still returns
HTTP 402 with a verified Vercel paused-deployment response. This is not a
generic payment-page classification. Other pricing, licensing and feature
statements retain their separately dated source checks.

nodes.label: Availability recheck: Curated Domains
nodes.summary:
The homepage returns HTTP 200 and
its domain extensions and linked naming examples are browsable. It still says
"full site coming soon" and "subscribe monthly". Active refers only to this
partial public directory, not a verified subscription flow. Other pricing,
licensing and feature statements retain their separately dated source checks.

nodes.label: Availability recheck: Sombra
nodes.summary:
The homepage returns HTTP 200 and
renders Sombra — Gradient Composer, including layers and a Copy React control.
The listed dark-mode gallery remains unverified. The domain is not dead; keep
the identity mismatch visible rather than treating the composer as the original
gallery. Other pricing, licensing and feature statements retain their separately
dated source checks.

nodes.label: Availability recheck: Designer News
nodes.summary:
The primary URL still returns
HTTP 402 with a verified paused-deployment response. Current stories and the
original discussion archive were not recovered. Other pricing, licensing and
feature statements retain their separately dated source checks.

nodes.label: Availability recheck: Butterfly
nodes.summary:
The primary URL responds, but no
usable landing-page builder was verified. A fresh browser could not obtain a
visible body before its wait timeout. The original builder workflow remains
unavailable; an HTTP success alone does not restore it. Other pricing, licensing
and feature statements retain their separately dated source checks.

nodes.label: Availability recheck: Replay
nodes.summary:
The primary URL returns HTTP 200
with the Replay session-recording title, but a fresh headless browser still
exposes no visible body, links or recording controls. This does not establish a
verified SDK or an operable recording workflow. Other pricing, licensing and
feature statements retain their separately dated source checks.

nodes.label: Availability recheck: Hexter UI
nodes.summary:
The primary domain still fails
DNS resolution (ENOTFOUND). No working primary-site workflow was verified; keep
this resource out of default search. Other pricing, licensing and feature
statements retain their separately dated source checks.

nodes.label: Availability recheck: Ninja UI
nodes.summary:
The primary URL redirects
successfully to Ninna UI with public component and installation documentation.
The existing doc already describes that current project. A catalogue spelling
mismatch is not evidence of an outage. Other pricing, licensing and feature
statements retain their separately dated source checks.

nodes.label: Availability recheck: RewampUI
nodes.summary:
The previously failing primary
domain now returns HTTP 200 and renders the RewampUI component showcase,
including Browse Components and the palakonweb/Rewamp-UI repository link. The
earlier DNS failure below is historical. Public visibility still does not
establish client-work licensing. Other pricing, licensing and feature statements
retain their separately dated source checks.

nodes.rationale: Export scripts and long install blocks must not become truncated executable fragments; a long command is replaced by a pointer to the doc while the full command stays in the machine-readable index.

nodes.label: Task 6: CLI Integration
nodes.rationale: The integration worker starts only after Tasks 1-4 modules are reviewed and combined, and it preserves security/path validation plus both existing JSON shapes, so wiring cannot regress the CLI's provenance guarantees.

nodes.label: Creator Links (#12)
nodes.rationale: Person gains optional created_tools IDs plus created_tools_evidence keyed by each ID with source_url, checked and a literal attribution quote. There is no fuzzy name/host join and absence is not proof a person made no tools, so only officially attributed credits are asserted.

nodes.label: execution_mode Vocabulary
nodes.rationale: One of registry, package, snippet, mcp-skill, browser-app, reference. It describes the primary documented workflow, not whether the site has a web page, so galleries are not classified as browser apps and no permission, cost or licence meaning is derived from it.

nodes.label: Search Contract (#6)
nodes.rationale: BM25-style term frequency and length normalization over name/identity, tags/stack, best_for, blurb and body, with weights calibrated against real queries rather than universal multipliers. Exact resource names rank first, motion libraries precede Blender for a hero-animation query, and filters run before ranking.

nodes.label: surface Vocabulary
nodes.rationale: A nonempty list of documented output/use domains (web-ui, web-3d, cli-tui, email, pdf, video, og-image, audio, comics, desktop, print, reference, web-asset, development, hosting, mobile-ui). More than one is allowed, but not a speculative list of all possible uses.

nodes.label: Bulk Research Fan-Out With Worker Briefs
nodes.norm_label: bulk research fan-out with worker briefs
nodes.rationale: catalogue.json is split into batches and each worker gets the worker brief plus its batch file, writing only the doc paths in that batch, so bulk research cannot sprawl outside its assignment.

nodes.label: Quarterly Refresh Cadence
nodes.rationale: Pricing drifts, so a quarterly sweep re-runs the research fan-out over docs whose last_verified is oldest.

nodes.label: Tool Doc Frontmatter Schema
nodes.rationale: Keys include paywall, pricing_summary, open_source, license, category_tags, best_for, stack, execution_mode, surface, status, agent_friendly and last_verified; these fields feed data/index.json and every filter in the CLI.

nodes.label: How to Use Section
nodes.rationale: Concrete numbered steps so an agent can go from the section to a finished result; for code libraries it carries the real install command and a minimal usage snippet. This is also the section later mined for the generated install field.

nodes.label: Nine H2 Headings
nodes.rationale: At a glance, What it is, Paywall and pricing, How to use, Examples, When to use it, Agent notes, Alternatives in this repo, Sources; a fixed order lets every reader and script jump straight to the section it needs.

nodes.label: tool-doc.md Template
nodes.rationale: The single contract every tool doc follows; checking docs against it is what makes the corpus uniformly parseable and index-generable.

nodes.label: Worker Brief Work Order
nodes.rationale: A worker writes exactly one Markdown file per batch entry at the entry's doc path and nothing else, creating the section directory if missing. Bounding the output path is what keeps parallel doc research mergeable.

nodes.label: The Two Rules (no invented facts, no hand-edited generated files)
nodes.norm_label: the two rules (no invented facts, no hand-edited generated files)
nodes.rationale: A change is good when every fact in it can be traced to the tool's official site on the date it says and bun run check passes.

nodes.label: Agent Retrieval Improvements Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Markdown stays authoritative and generated index fields remain derived; pure modules implement validation, ranking, extraction, cards and availability. No embeddings, vector database or network search are allowed, so retrieval stays local and deterministic.

nodes.label: Agent Retrieval Improvements Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Baseline commit 0b10971 has 441 registered docs, 64 passing tests and zero doc errors; the original checkout holds unrelated local graph changes and untracked files that must stay untouched, so work happens in isolated integration and worker worktrees.

nodes.label: Verification Gate
nodes.rationale: Closing an issue requires its acceptance checks, not a worker report: bun test, index, check, format, format:check and smoke:release must pass, index regeneration must be idempotent, and staged paths are checked for downloaded assets and unrelated graph changes.
